content: What five functional teams can I make with my roster? Until now, I've mostly been focusing on the story, and most of my characters are underleveled. So in whom should I invest my precious elixirs? 🤔

Hello there : )

First : you might want to get all 19 of your selection up to lvl 40 at least, preferably 50. Don't forget to upgrade their skills as well.

As for what team, I'd recommand you first select your 4 favorite awakeners.
It *is* a game so it might be more meaningful to choose your teams based on what feels more interesting to you : )

I've been pulling for Caecus ever since I began the game (I was also pulling for Saya too). After that, I continued to pull on Aequor for Celeste and hopefully more Caecus. The problem emerges when I keep only getting Goliath (even on banners that aren't standard). I HATE GOLIATH but i'm using him unwillingly. I really want another Caecus tho. Should I keep gambling on Aequor and risk getting another Goliath? I've gotten a bunch of other awakeners too but Goliath has consistently shown up uninvited.<:Caecus_cry:1356068126894194758>  My team is Celeste, Goliath, Aigis, and Caecus for now..
